full_name: Rochelle Feinstein | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2012–2013 Arts Mildred Londa Weisman Fellow Yale University
bio: Rochelle Feinstein lives and works in New York. Her recent solo exhibitions include The Estate of Rochelle F. at On Stellar Rays in New York City (2011) and I Made a Terrible Mistake at APF Lab in New York City (2009). She has also had solo shows at Momenta Art in Brooklyn (2008) and The Suburban in Chicago.
